experiment: H7 sound n=10 non-existence scan -- streaming+sharding wrapper + timed shard probe

xval_result.note: streaming+sharding wrapper reproduces the validated brute counts and max_chi=2 at n=6,7,8 exactly (0 mismatches) -> wrapper is SOUND; reuses the byte-identical _orient generator + is_C3 + dichromatic pipeline from m3_lb_scan_n9.py

partial_conclusion: Across 1500 K4-free connected base graphs on 10 vertices (a deterministic stride-200 shard, 686258 C_3 digraphs), max_chi_in_C3 == 2 and NO chi>=3 witness. SOUND partial evidence consistent with m(3)>=11; does NOT yet establish m(3)>=11 (that requires the COMPLETE n=10 scan: all ~4.3M K4-free connected base graphs, all 200 shards clean).

cost_estimate.shardable: embarrassingly parallel over --shards/--shard; deterministic disjoint partition, resumable across sessions/machines
cost_estimate.note: n=9 full scan was ~1187s; the ~310x wall jump matches the ~45x base-graph blowup times the higher per-graph C_3 density/chi cost at n=10. A complete n=10 scan is an engineering/compute push of ~order 100 CPU-hours, beyond a single executor turn but feasible as a sharded campaign.
